question: كم عدد الأفلام في قاعدة البيانات؟
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film;

question: كم عدد الممثلين؟
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM actor;

question: كم عدد العملاء؟
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer;

question: كم عدد العملاء النشطين؟
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer WHERE active = 1;

question: ما أقصى مدة فيلم بالدقائق في قاعدة البيانات؟
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(length) FROM film;

question: ما متوسط سعر استئجار الأفلام؟
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(rental_rate), 2) FROM film;

question: اعرض عناوين الأفلام التي تصنيفها PG-13 ومدتها أكثر من 180 دقيقة.
gold_sql: SELECT title, length FROM film WHERE rating = 'PG-13' AND length > 180 ORDER BY title;

question: كم عدد الأفلام في كل تصنيف عمري؟
gold_sql: SELECT rating, COUNT(*) AS n FROM film GROUP BY rating ORDER BY n DESC, rating;

question: اعرض العملاء الذين يبدأ اسمهم الأول بحرف A.
gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM customer WHERE first_name LIKE 'A%' ORDER BY first_name, last_name;

question: كم عدد الأفلام في كل فئة؟
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM film_category fc JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY n DESC, c.name;

question: من هم أكثر 5 ممثلين ظهورًا في الأفلام؟
gold_sql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, COUNT(*) AS films FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name ORDER BY films DESC, a.last_name, a.first_name LIMIT 5;

question: ما أسماء الممثلين في فيلم ACADEMY DINOSAUR؟
gold_sql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id JOIN film f ON fa.film_id = f.film_id WHERE f.title = 'ACADEMY DINOSAUR' ORDER BY a.last_name, a.first_name;

question: كم عدد نسخ الأفلام في المخزون لكل متجر؟
gold_sql: SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS copies FROM inventory GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id;

question: ما إجمالي مبالغ المدفوعات؟
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) FROM payment;

question: ما إجمالي الإيرادات لكل متجر؟
gold_sql: SELECT i.store_id, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS revenue FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id GROUP BY i.store_id ORDER BY i.store_id;

question: من هم أكثر 10 عملاء إنفاقًا؟
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS total FROM customer c JOIN payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY total DESC, c.customer_id LIMIT 10;

question: ما العملاء الذين لم يستأجروا أي فيلم؟
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rental r WHERE r.customer_id = c.customer_id) ORDER BY c.customer_id;

question: كم فيلمًا لا توجد له أي نسخة في المخزون؟
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film WHERE film_id NOT IN (SELECT film_id FROM inventory);

question: كم مرة استأجر العميل رقم 1 أفلامًا؟
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rental WHERE customer_id = 1;

question: ما الدول التي يزيد عدد عملائها عن 30 عميلًا؟
gold_sql: SELECT co.country, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON cu.address_id = a.address_id JOIN city ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id JOIN country co ON ci.country_id = co.country_id GROUP BY co.country HAVING COUNT(*) > 30 ORDER BY n DESC, co.country;

question: ما أكثر 5 دول من حيث عدد العملاء؟
gold_sql: SELECT co.country, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON cu.address_id = a.address_id JOIN city ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id JOIN country co ON ci.country_id = co.country_id GROUP BY co.country ORDER BY n DESC, co.country LIMIT 5;

question: كم عملية استئجار تمت خلال أغسطس 2005؟
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rental WHERE rental_date >= '2005-08-01' AND rental_date < '2005-09-01';

question: ما الإيرادات الشهرية من المدفوعات؟
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', payment_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS revenue FROM payment GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

question: ما الفيلم الأكثر استئجارًا؟
gold_sql: SELECT f.title, COUNT(*) AS n FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title ORDER BY n DESC, f.title LIMIT 1;

question: كم فيلمًا سعر استئجاره أعلى من متوسط سعر الاستئجار؟
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film WHERE rental_rate > (SELECT AVG(rental_rate) FROM film);

question: ما متوسط مدة الأفلام في كل فئة؟
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(AVG(f.length), 2) AS avg_length FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY avg_length DESC, c.name;

question: ما نسبة الأفلام ذات التصنيف G من إجمالي الأفلام؟
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 'G' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM film;

question: من هم العملاء الذين استأجروا أكثر من 40 فيلمًا؟
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customer c JOIN rental r ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 40 ORDER BY n DESC, c.customer_id;

question: أي موظف نفّذ أكبر عدد من عمليات الاستئجار؟
gold_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM rental r JOIN staff s ON r.staff_id = s.staff_id GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name ORDER BY n DESC, s.staff_id LIMIT 1;

question: كم فيلمًا لكل لغة؟
gold_sql: SELECT l.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM film f JOIN language l ON f.language_id = l.language_id GROUP BY l.name ORDER BY n DESC, l.name;

question: ما أطول فيلم في كل فئة؟
gold_sql: SELECT name, title, length FROM (SELECT c.name, f.title, f.length, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_id ORDER BY f.length DESC) AS rnk FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id) t WHERE rnk = 1 ORDER BY name, title;

question: ما عناوين الأفلام التي استأجرها العميل رقم 1؟
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT f.title FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE r.customer_id = 1 ORDER BY f.title;

question: ما عدد الأفلام لكل تصنيف عمري مرتبة تنازليًا؟

question: ما إجمالي الإيرادات لكل فئة أفلام؟
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS revenue FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC, c.name;

question: ما ترتيب العملاء حسب إجمالي الإنفاق (أعلى 10)؟
gold_sql: SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS rnk, customer_id, total FROM (SELECT customer_id, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id) ORDER BY rnk LIMIT 10;

question: ما أكثر 5 لغات من حيث عدد الأفلام؟
gold_sql: SELECT l.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM film f JOIN language l ON f.language_id = l.language_id GROUP BY l.name ORDER BY n DESC, l.name LIMIT 5;

question: ما أكثر 5 أفلام من حيث عدد الممثلين؟
gold_sql: SELECT f.title, COUNT(*) AS n FROM film f JOIN film_actor fa ON f.film_id = fa.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title ORDER BY n DESC, f.title LIMIT 5;

question: كم عدد الأفلام التي مدتها بين 90 و120 دقيقة؟

question: ما أكثر 10 عملاء من حيث عدد عمليات الاستئجار؟
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customer c JOIN rental r ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY n DESC, c.customer_id LIMIT 10;

question: كم عدد الدفعات لكل متجر؟
gold_sql: SELECT s.store_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM payment p JOIN staff s ON p.staff_id = s.staff_id GROUP BY s.store_id ORDER BY s.store_id;

question: ما متوسط مبلغ الدفعة لكل فئة أفلام؟
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(AVG(p.amount), 2) AS avg_payment FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY avg_payment DESC;
